Fanged lizards

Original: https://shrouded-lands.fandom.com/wiki/Fanged_lizards

|thumb|400px|’Inostrancevia alexandri and Scutosaurus karpinski’, Dmitry Bogdanov (CC BY 3.0 Unported)]] Fanged lizards or fangbeasts are used as mounts by the outriders of lizardman caravans. When knights attacked Smuggler’s Isle (17.16, the fanged lizards ripped them to shreds.
